page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highmem-8 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB of system memory. Powered by an AMD EPYC 7B12 processor using the x86_64 architecture, this server features 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core and dedicated CPU allocation. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache. There is no bundled local storage or GPU acceleration included with this instance type.

Benchmark evaluations show strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the top 25 percent at 2681.48. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally fall into the average range, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 5778.0 and uncached memory read bandwidth of 69.61 GB/sec. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark extended instructions tests represent relative performance bottlenecks, scoring in the bottom 25 percent.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB of RAM per vCPU, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-performance local storage or GPU acceleration. It is well suited for database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and lightweight language model inference tasks.
